description: Per-metal test-AUC + Wasserstein pIC50 final-loss from Wf-124 P3 / Wf-200 v3 chemprop v2 multi-task driver.  Plumbing-only emission (no re-training).
scope: Wf-200 v3 per-seed JSONs across metals {Ru,Ir,Os,Rh,Re}
honest_framing_note: Wf-252-Apply Fix #3 (F3-M11Emit) plumbing emission.  Reads Wf-200 v3 per-seed JSONs from /home/hugo/codes/mol-metal/molmetal/reports/wf200_chemprop_v2_v3 (no model re-training, no GPU).  4 per-seed runs across 3/5 metals.  Wf-200 v3 driver populated Ru/Ir/Os (3 metals) for seed 0; Ru seed 1 also present.  Rh/Re have no per-seed JSONs at this point (the underlying Wf-124 P3 multi-task Wasserstein training did not complete for these metals before the session budget expired).  test_auc_std is population std (pstdev), zero when n_runs=1.  w2_final is the last-epoch Wasserstein transfer loss per run; the Wf-200 driver bounded W2 to max 32 rows per metal per step as an O(N²) cost bound — these are NOT paper-grade Wasserstein distances.
